Primary Care Progress Note
Date: 08/07/2026
Patient: Stanley O'Conner, 84 y/o M

CC: Back pain

HPI: Back pain since 07/28/2026 after lifting a laundry basket. No radicular sx noted. Denies numbness or weakness.

PE: Tenderness over lumbar paraspinals. No step-offs or deformities. Neuro exam intact.

Assessment: Acute mechanical back pain.

Plan: Advise activity modification, NSAIDs prn. Follow-up prn worsening or new sx.

Spine Intervention Consultation
Date: 09/21/2026
Patient: Stanley O'Conner, 84 y/o M

HPI: Outpt, not admitted. NRS 5/10 despite 7 wks NSM (oxycodone 5 mg as needed, TLSO brace). Pain stable/slightly better.

Exam: Pain at fx level; afebrile, no infx signs.

Plan: Referred for DEXA + osteoporosis program. Consider vertebral augmentation if pain worsens or fails to improve further.

Summary: Patient with vertebral compression fracture managed conservatively with analgesics and bracing. Close follow-up advised.
